test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **'both'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The proverb is interpreted as someone trying to catch two hares at once, symbolizing the attempt to achieve two goals simultaneously. (कोई एक साथ दो खरगोशों को पकड़ने की कोशिश कर रहा है, जो एक साथ दो लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के प्रयास का प्रतीक है)
 
• 'Everything', 'nothing', and 'equal' do not accurately echo the intended lesson from the proverb about the risk of pursuing two goals at the same time.
 
• **'Both' **perfectly fits as it conveys the pitfall of this situation: ending up losing both opportunities because of divided focus.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***'both'.***

*The Complete Passage is__ *A stone that is constantly rolling cannot gather moss , while a stone that remains lying in one (1) __place__ will gather it after a time. In the same way, a man who is a rolling stone, who is constantly (2) __changing__ his occupations and pursuits, and does not settle (3) __down__ long for any particular work, achieves little or no (4) __success__ in life. One who is constantly chopping and changing will never become wealthy and get success in life. He will merely be dissipating his energies, and will get nowhere. As the proverb says , ‘He who hunts two hares, loses (5) __**both**__’. 

150:T48f,
The correct answer is **Option (4).**
